slides.texte_overlay:
5 LOW-EFFORT HABITS THAT
GIVE YOU CONTROL

1. MAKE YOUR BED.
Two minutes.
The first win of the day.

2. PREP TOMORROW TONIGHT.
Clothes out. Bag packed.
Morning you will thank you.

3. ONE APP-FREE HOUR.
Every evening. Phone in a drawer.
Your head gets quiet.

4. WALK AFTER DINNER.
Ten minutes outside.
The day settles.

5. ONE LESSON A DAY.
Five minutes of learning.
Proof you're still growing.
